description: The Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad by the Madhya Pradesh Government provides aid to 20 students yearly with family income under ₹8 lakh, 75% in postgraduation, and teaching experience or an M.Phil degree.

name: State Government Backward Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 10)
description: The scheme is implemented by the School Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, aims to ensure the continuity of education for students from the Backward Classes. Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to Backward Classes students studying in Classes 6 to 10.

name: State Government SC Scholarship (Class 1 to 10)

description: The scheme was launched by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to give benefits for improving the educational status of scheduled tribe students. Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 1 to 8.

description: The scheme was launched by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to encourage education among Scheduled Tribe students and improve their educational status. This scheme provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 9 and 10.

name: Strengthening Skills, Arts and Employment through ITIs

name: Student Welfare Scheme
description: The objective of the scheme is to provide assistance to economically weaker ST students to meet their emergency needs in special circumstances. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to ST students studying in Class 1 to 10 in cases of urgency or emergency.

name: Sudama Shishyavritti Scheme (Class 11th and 12th)
description: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Class 11 and Class 12 in government schools who reside in a hostel, have an annual family income of less than ₹1,00,000/-, and belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

name: Super 5000
description: In 2017, Madhya Pradesh State Government started a scheme "Super 5000" for student scholarships.

name: Supply of Kadaknath Chicks on Subsidy

name: Swami Vivekananda Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Class 11th & 12th)

name: Tap Water Scheme (Nal Jal Yojana)

name: Tool/Equipment Purchase Subsidy Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
description: Launched on January 1, 2018, the "Tool/Equipment Purchase Subsidy Scheme" provides financial assistance to construction workers registered under the M.P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for the purchase of tools and equipment related to their work.

name: Top Working Program

name: Training on Artificial Insemination for Self-Employment
description: The "Training on Artificial Insemination for Self-Employment" by the Animal Husbandry Department, Madhya Pradesh promotes milk production and employment. Trained Gausevaks get an honorarium of ₹4,000 and equipment worth ₹18,000.

name: Tuition Fee Reimbursement of Sainik/Public Schools

description: Under this scheme, ₹15,000 is provided per case for the marriage of a daughter (above 18 years of age) of workers/employees working in institutions covered under the Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Fund Act, 1982, or to a female worker herself.

name: Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme
description: The scheme aims to provide crop insurance protection to farmers against weather-related risks under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana. It ensures financial support to farmers affected by adverse weather conditions.

name: Youth Art Training Fellowship Scheme
description: The scheme aims to encourage youth in arts by providing a monthly fellowship and professional training through government institutions.
